data.name: Glooky: Cursors in the City
data.detailed_description:
Glooky: Cursors in the City is a co-op driven game in which you and your duo play as cursors trying to leave a dark and decrepit city. Solve puzzles using mechanisms scattered around the city and make your way through the districts of Glooky.

The cursors can take control of many characters. Activate mechanisms with the pudgy hands of a salary man, push heavy objects around with the strength of the punk, move heavy machinery in tandem with your buddy by controlling each tread of a vehicle.

Your journey will take you through many neighborhoods, most of which are getting rebuilt by the GlooKorp, a real estate developer. From the dilapidated to the most luxurious districts, wander around the many environments of Glooky.

You’ll encounter the inhabitants of the city along the way but don’t forget about your teammate! Otherwise, they could sabotage you by bumping your character over fences or fight you in an intense boxing match. But whatever the outcome, you’ll have to put your differences aside if you want to uncover the dark and twisted secret behind the GlooKorp…
